source.label: FY26 Sustainability Report (ASX, 20 August 2026), People
source.quote: In FY26, Fortescue’s total workforce increased by 0.9 per cent to 16,154 employees.

source.label: FY26 Annual Report and Appendix 4E (ASX, 20 August 2026), note 06 Other expenses
source.quote: Total employee benefits expense included in cost of sales, administration expenses and research expenditure is US$2,253 million (2025: US$2,098 million).

notes: Employees: the annual report gives no head count; the FY26 Sustainability Report, lodged on the ASX with it, gives the total workforce of 16,154 employees for FY26 (it does not say whether this is a year-end head count or an average; contractors are not included). Payroll: total employee benefits expense from the annual report's notes, in US$ (it includes share-based payments).
